title: README: remove the "Look first, install nothing → Open the CRM example on StackBlitz" row (maintainer: StackBlitz is unreliable and ruled out)
body:
## Ruling (maintainer, verbatim)

Maintainer, 2026-11-12, in the www.objectos.ai seat 1 session:

- 「stackblitz 实际不好用，也很卡，也很容易出问题的，之前建议全部作废的」
- 「你直接派发处理，objectstack README 里那句 StackBlitz也删掉」

The maintainer told the seat to dispatch this card directly, so triage routing is skipped for this one card. The source of that instruction is quoted above.

## Fact

`README.md:46` (main) is the quick-start table row `| Look first, install nothing | [Open the CRM example on StackBlitz](https://stackblitz.com/github/objectstack-ai/hotcrm) | It runs in the browser. |`.

The website already removed its StackBlitz CTA under the same ruling: www.objectos.ai #408, PR #409, merged 60eddd2.

## Work

1. Delete that README row.
2. Check that no other README or docs text points to StackBlitz, using `git grep -i stackblitz -- README.md content/docs`. Remove any hit, or report it if removing it is not a one-line change.
3. Run the repo's README checks, such as `scripts/check-published-readme-links.mjs`, if they apply.
4. Leave the T1–T4 positioning lines (`README.md` 7–14, 27–31) untouched. www's `check-positioning` pins them.

## Done when

`git grep -i stackblitz -- README.md content/docs` prints nothing.
